entries.t: 南京大学谭海仁基于混合顺序沉积方法在湿膜过程引入正丁基铵硫氰酸盐以提高钙钛矿层质量
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能源测/发电技术/光伏
entries.as: 南京大学谭海仁团队针对钙钛矿/晶硅叠层电池在湿气环境下结晶质量差的问题，开发"湿膜干预"策略，在混合顺序沉积法的MACl介导湿膜阶段引入正丁基铵硫氰酸盐（nBASCN）。SCN⁻调控结晶路径、解耦有机盐扩散与钙钛矿结晶、诱导二次晶粒生长并与Pb²⁺配位，在35%-65%相对湿度下制备高质量钙钛矿层，推动空气环境规模化生产。
entries.b:
钙钛矿/晶硅叠层电池产业化面临着空气中湿度对高质量钙钛矿薄膜制备干扰的问题，如不受控的水分会引发无序结晶、晶粒质量差，并使钙钛矿表面分解，积累过量PbI₂，阻碍载流子传输。而现有制备方法或依赖惰性环境（成本高），或在空气环境下制备得到的器件效率较低（1cm²器件效率为28.7%，16cm²为26.3%），难以满足规模化生产需求。
近日，南京大学谭海仁教授团队通过探究了环境湿度下不同类型添加剂对钙钛矿结晶行为的影响，开发出一种使用硫氰酸盐的“湿膜干预”策略。该研究基于双面工业级绒面硅衬底结合混合顺序沉积的钙钛矿制备技术，采用混合顺序沉积法（共蒸发无机框架+溶液处理有机盐），小面积器件用刮涂、大面积用狭缝模头涂覆（均在35%-65%相对湿度RH下进行）。其在MACl介导的湿膜阶段引入正丁基铵硫氰酸盐（n-butylammonium thiocyanate，nBASCN）溶液，后续经125℃退火20min完成制备。添加剂中，SCN⁻可调控结晶，将有机盐扩散与钙钛矿结晶的解耦，在湿度环境下构建更可控的结晶路径，诱导二次晶粒生长，并与欠配位Pb²⁺发生配位作用，降低α相形成能并促使（100）晶面表面能最小化，诱导晶核沿（100）晶面迅速生长，实现晶粒尺寸和结晶度的提升及择优取向；nBA⁺能平衡疏水性与电荷传输，形成自挥发2D疏水屏障，规避传统添加剂的吸湿或绝缘问题，同时残留阳离子能填充表面空位、钝化缺陷，避免过量损害载流子传输的低维相和绝缘性长链聚集体在界面形成，改善界面接触与载流子传输。测试结果证明，该策略实现了体相非辐射复合和表面缺陷的减少、载流子寿命增长；表面电势均匀化且n型特征增强，有利于电子传输层接触及界面处载流子的提取。
由此制备的1 cm²的单结器件（ITO/NiOₓ+MeO-2PACz/nBASCN处理perovskite/C60+SnOₓ/Cu或IZO+Ag）效率（PCE）可达20.22%。全纹理化钙钛矿/硅异质结（SHJ）叠层器件（孔径面积1.1664 cm²）反向扫描效率达到30.71%（VOC = 1.900 V，JSC = 20.27 mA cm⁻²，FF = 79.93%）；采用与产线兼容的狭缝涂布工艺制备的孔径面积为16 cm²的大面积钙钛矿/硅叠层电池效率达29.09%（VOC = 1.897 V，JSC = 19.35 mA cm⁻²，FF = 79.27%）。N₂氛围下2928h无明显衰减；未封装器件在50%RH下480h保留90.6%初始效率，85℃下504h保留89.3%；封装大面积器件在30%-50% RH、模拟1sun光照下930h仍保留88%效率。文章于2026年1月20日发表在Joule。

entries.t: 锂金属电池中的异相电荷转移机制：通过Marcus理论揭示异常亲锂性
entries.a: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能量存储/电化学储能/二次电池/锂电池
entries.as: 该研究利用Marcus电子转移理论揭示了锂金属电池中异质电荷转移机制，阐明了锂金属负极表面'异常亲锂性'（abnormal lithiophilicity）的物理本质。锂金属电池具有高能量密度，但锂的不均匀电沉积和枝晶生长导致库伦效率低和安全隐患。研究发现，传统基于表面能的亲锂性判断标准存在局限，某些看似疏锂的表面实际表现出优异的锂沉积行为。通过Marcus理论分析电荷转移动力学，研究重新定义了亲锂性判据，为理性设计稳定锂金属负极界面层和集流体涂层提供了理论指导。
kp: [发现]: Li沉积动力学反常依赖亲锂性
entries.b: Li metal batteries offer a high energy density but suffer from nonuniform Li metal electroplating and dendrite formation, limiting practical use. These issues arise from complex interfacial charge transfer kinetics, which are still ambiguously defined. Here, we reveal an abnormal dependence of Li electrodeposition kinetics on substrate lithiophilicity, rationalized by the Marcus-Hush-Chidsey (MHC) theory. Contrary to conventional expectations, lithiophobic Cu enables faster electron transfer and more stable Li electroplating at high overpotentials, whereas lithiophilic Au performs better at low overpotentials. This crossover behavior establishes a current density-dependent framework that redefines the classical understanding of lithiophilicity. Electrochemical characterizations, MHC-based modeling, and crystal orbital Hamilton population analysis attribute the phenomenon to an interplay between reorganization energy and electronic coupling strength. The findings, validated across various substrates and electrolytes, provide general mechanistic insights into heterogeneous charge transfer during Li electroplating and suggest new strategies for interface design in anodeless Li metal batteries.

entries.t: 硬碳上聚合物诱导的固体电解质界面层实现5C快充实用化钠离子软包电池
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能量存储/电化学储能/二次电池/钠电池
entries.as: 该研究提出一种聚合物诱导固体电解质界面（SEI）策略，在硬碳负极表面构建富含阴离子的界面层。通过引入具有强极性特征的含氟基团（2F基团），在硬碳与聚合物界面处诱导阴离子富集，形成稳定的SEI膜，从而显著降低界面阻抗并抑制副反应。该策略使硬碳负极在5C倍率下实现稳定快充，为钠离子/锂离子电池高倍率充放电提供了新的界面工程思路，有望推动快充电池的工程化应用。
kp: SEI组成[硬碳]: 聚合物与NaF杂化
充电倍率[钠离子软包电池]: 5C快充
entries.b: Achieving 2F group attached has a powerful polar feature, which simultaneously induces anion enriched at the PolyHC interface and tailors extra F atoms, contributing to the architecture of a ∼5.0 nm stable SEI that hybridizes polymer and NaF. This SEI with a resilient polymer skeleton permanently holds the generated inorganic component, enabling long-term structural stability during fast-charging. The assembled 1.2 Ah pouch cell, paired with NaNi1/3Fe1/3Mn1/3O2 cathode and PolyHC anode, displays exceptional fast-charging capability and durability. This method is compatible with various HC, offering a novel perspective for modulating the HC interface chemistry.

entries.t: AI辅助化学合成中的集体智能
entries.c: AI与智能科技/AI软件层/工程改进/AGENT
entries.as: 该研究提出利用集体智能辅助化学合成的框架。科学文献呈指数级增长，跨学科研究者面临信息过载的严峻挑战。研究整合AI驱动的文献挖掘、反应预测和知识图谱技术，从海量已发表文献中自动提取化学反应规则、条件优化数据和底物适用范围，构建可协作更新的化学合成知识库。通过集体智能模式汇聚全球化学家的隐性经验和实验数据，AI系统可为新分子合成路径设计提供数据驱动的智能建议。该方向有望显著加速药物研发和新材料发现流程。
kp: [AI辅助合成]: 大语言模型+集体智能实现可靠化学反应转化
entries.b: The exponential growth of scientific literature presents an increasingly acute challenge across disciplines. Hundreds of thousands of new chemical reactions are reported annually, yet translating them into actionable experiments becomes an obstacle1,2. Recent applications of large language models (LLMs) have shown promise3,4,5,6, but systems that reliably work for diverse transformations across de novo compounds have remained elusive. Here we introduce MOSAIC (Multiple Optimized Specialists for AI-assisted Chemical Prediction), a computational framework that enables chemists to harness the collective knowledge of millions of reaction protocols. MOSAIC is built upon the Llama-3.1-8B-instruct architecture7, training 2,498 specialized chemical experts within Voronoi-clustered spaces. This approach delivers reproducible and executable experimental protocols with confidence metrics for complex syntheses. With an overall 71% success rate, experimental validation demonstrates the realizations of over 35 novel compounds, spanning pharmaceuticals, materials, agrochemicals, and cosmetics. Notably, MOSAIC also enables the discovery of new reaction methodologies that are absent from the expert’s training, a cornerstone for advancing chemical synthesis. This scalable paradigm of partitioning vast domains into searchable expert regions enables a generalizable strategy for AI-assisted discovery wherever accelerating information growth outpaces efficient knowledge access and application.

entries.t: 构建三维共价有机框架用于光催化合成2,3-二氢苯并呋喃衍生物
entries.a: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
entries.as: 该研究构建了三维共价有机框架（3D COFs），并将其作为光催化剂用于2,3-二氢苯并呋喃衍生物的合成。2,3-二氢苯并呋喃结构广泛存在于天然产物和药物分子中，在制药和材料科学领域具有重要价值。研究利用3D COF的多孔结构和光吸收特性，在温和条件下实现光催化成环反应，高效构建目标杂环分子，为绿色合成药学相关骨架提供了新策略。
kp: 催化剂[光催化合成]: 3D COF(D-A结构)
entries.b: 2,3-Dihydrobenzofuran derivatives hold significant value in pharmaceutical and material science due to their prevalence in bioactive molecules and natural products. However, constructing efficient and sustainable catalytic systems for the synthesis of such derivatives remains challenging. Herein, we synthesized two three-dimensional covalent organic frameworks (3D COFs) with donor-acceptor (D-A) units, which enable efficient photocatalytic synthesis of 2,3-dihydrobenzofuran derivatives via oxidative dehydrogenative coupling of alkenyl phenols (12 substrate examples, up to 95% yields) or oxidative [3 + 2] cycloaddition of phenols and olefins (14 substrate examples, up to 97% yields). Remarkably, a range of natural products, including δ-viniferin, conocarpan, licarin A, homopterocarpin, and pterocarpan, can be facilely and scalably synthesized through a one-step synthesis in high yields (up to 93%), in sharp contrast to multistep routes required by conventional approaches with lower yields (<60%). Comprehensive characterizations reveal that the synthesized 3D COFs with D-A units enable efficient photoinduced carrier separation and migration, thus facilitating the photocatalytic performance. Moreover, the interconnected nanochannels and rigid frameworks in 3D COFs collectively ensure substrate accessibility and structural stability (at least 10 catalytic cycles), much superior to that of the corresponding two-dimensional (2D) COFs. This work provides an innovative approach for facile and efficient photosynthesis of high-value-added chemicals by 3D COFs.

entries.t: 将 RNA 降解转化为准确的 RNA 检测：临床样品的 RNase I 辅助滚环扩增
entries.a: Wiley: Angewandte Chemie International Edition: Table of Contents
entries.c: 通用技术/检测和表征/先进科学仪器
entries.as: 该研究提出了一种创新的RNase I辅助滚环扩增（RI-RCA）技术，成功将RNA降解酶的破坏作用转化为检测优势。传统上，核糖核酸酶因快速切割RNA被视为诊断障碍。该技术结合酶反应与扩增机制，有效克服了临床样本中大型RNA分子复杂二级结构和背景RNA干扰的难题，实现了高特异性和高准确度的RNA检测，为临床诊断提供了新工具。
entries.b:
Abstract
                  
                    Ribonucleases are powerful degradative enzymes that rapidly cleave RNA and have long been regarded as obstacles to RNA diagnostics. Detecting large, structured RNA molecules in biological samples is further complicated by extensive secondary structures and abundant background RNA. Here we transform this destructive activity into a diagnostic advantage through a RNase I–assisted rolling circle amplification (RI‐RCA) strategy that integrates enzymatic RNA digestion with circular DNA templates (CDTs) to achieve direct, reverse‐transcription‐free RNA detection. In this system,
                    Escherichia coli
                    RNase I—a widely available endoribonuclease—selectively digests structured RNA to expose complementary CDT‐binding sites, which are immediately protected through duplex formation and converted into primers for RCA. The resulting reaction proceeds isothermally at room temperature in linear, quasi‐exponential, and exponential modes, achieving quantitative signal generation across concentrations from 50 aM to 50 fM and maintaining performance in 50% pooled human saliva. Applied to clinical saliva samples from SARS‐CoV‐2–positive and –negative individuals, RI‐RCA achieved near‐perfect sensitivity and 98–100% diagnostic accuracy. By coupling enzymatic RNA digestion with sequence‐specific protection via CDT hybridization, this strategy converts RNA instability from a liability into an analytical advantage, providing a simple, robust, and clinically translatable platform for accurate detection of structured RNA targets.
